main_idea: BAR-informed harness changes improved legal-agent output quality by 5%.
ideas: BAR evaluates agents on end-to-end legal work.
BAR covers 5,161 cases, 28 practice areas, and 11,075 documents.
One expert-validated synthetic case was published.
BAR-informed harness changes improved output quality by 5%.
summary: The oversized evaluation process, benchmark overview, and secondary dataset counts crowd the 5% result; nothing essential is missing.
